name: Shell
description: What the shell itself reads and writes, which is not one app's: the chat's history, and (in the blocks the other shell lanes add) Home, search and the vault's plumbing. It is parsed like an app manifest and is not one of the eight apps: the assistant's catalogue and the training harness do not carry it.

queries.name: holdings
queries.description: (vault plumbing, lane H2) The vaults this phone holds: each one's id, name and how it stands (in front, resting, keyed, kept on its own words, frozen with the date and the count of changes no gateway acknowledged), the one in front first. Answered by the shelf, not by a vault: it is the one shell read the front core keeps for itself.

queries.name: chats
queries.description: The chat drawer's list, newest activity first; with a term, the chats it finds by title and by the member's own words, best first, with the words it corrected a typo to.

queries.name: chat
queries.description: One stored chat and its messages, oldest first, each with its cards and attachments as they were said.

queries.name: chat-card
queries.description: Whether the row a stored card names is still in the vault.

queries.name: files-followed
queries.description: (imports, lane I) The folders the vault follows, with the documents each still holds and each file's last stated stat, so a rescan of an unchanged folder reads no bytes.

queries.name: backup-status
queries.description: (backup, lane H2) Where this vault's backup stands, read from the phone's own ledger without dialling anyone: the gateways it is paired with, when one last acknowledged the head (the gateway's clock), how many photos and files are confirmed of how many the vault knows, what waits and why, and this phone's clock for wording. Re-read whenever a pass, a pairing or a forget moves the ledger, or the vault's files change.

queries.name: search
queries.description: Home's vault search: every searchable app's rows for one term in one answer (notes, people, agenda, tasks, photos, docs, Locker items by their plain text, and the named containers and chat threads), at most eight of each kind, under the owner. Blank answers no hits. `corrected` names the words searched when the typed ones found little and a correction added rows.

actions.name: rename-chat
phrasings: change the title of this chat
actions.description: Rename a stored chat through thread.rename.

actions.name: delete-chat
actions.description: Delete one stored chat with its messages for good through entity.purge: a chat has no trash.

actions.name: clear-chats
actions.description: Delete every stored chat in this vault for good through thread.clear.

actions.name: follow-files
phrasings: keep a folder of files in step
import the files of a folder
actions.description: (imports, lane I) Follow a folder of the phone's files through follow.files, one folder at a time: a file the vault lacks becomes a document in the folder's own Docs folder, a changed file a new revision, one gone from a complete read goes to the trash if the member never touched it.

actions.name: claim-bytes
phrasings: claim the bytes I just staged
actions.description: (imports, lane I) Name bytes the stage door stored through blob.stage, at the size the core counted, so no stored bytes sit in the vault that nothing names.

actions.name: stop-following-files
actions.description: (imports, lane I) Stop following a folder through follow.stop: its sources are forgotten and the origin retired; every document stays.
